description.en: Local-first pentest intelligence memory as a native DeepSeek Harness panel: vulnerability board, internal operations, 3D Memory Nebula, assets, snapshots, retest, Web Fuzzer and mini-program (wxapkg) reversing, plus 22 native agent tools that use the local Cortex SQLite without MCP.
description.zh: 本地优先的渗透测试情报记忆，作为 DeepSeek Harness 原生面板：漏洞看板、内网作战、3D 记忆星云、资产库、认知快照、漏洞复测、Web Fuzzer 与小程序逆向（wxapkg 检测/解密/解包/分析），并内置 22 个原生 Agent 工具，直接读写本地 Cortex SQLite，无需 MCP。

description.en: Cortex workbench for DSH: the original Cortex UI (vulnerabilities, assets, internal operations, Memory Nebula, snapshots, retest, Web Fuzzer, mini-program reversing) as a native panel, plus 22 cortex_* agent tools and an injected usage prompt.
description.zh: DSH 版 Cortex 工作台：原版 Cortex UI（漏洞、资产、内网作战、记忆星云、快照、复测、Web Fuzzer、小程序逆向）原生面板，外加 22 个 cortex_* Agent 工具与自动注入的使用提示。
